AKASH PALANKAR

Business Analyst

Email: akashpalankar405@gmail.com | Phone: +91 8123859405 | Location: Bengaluru, India | LinkedIn

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Technical Business Analyst with 4+ years of experience in requirements gathering, business process analysis, and data-driven decision support. Experienced in leveraging AI-driven analytics and automation to enhance reporting, improve decision-making, and optimize business workflows. Strong expertise in translating business requirements into functional solutions, conducting gap analysis, and supporting stakeholders across cross-functional teams.

Proficient in SQL, Excel, Tableau, JIRA, and AI tools for data analysis and insights generation, with hands-on experience in Agile (Scrum) and Waterfall methodologies. Proven track record of delivering high-value projects on time while driving operational efficiency and business outcomes.

EDUCATION

Vignan's Foundation for Science, Technology & Research	05/2023 - 06/2025

Master Business Administration MBA (Information Technology)

JSS SMI UG & PG STUDIES VIDYAGIRI DHARWAD	06/2016 – 06/2020

Bachelor of Business Administration (Marketing)

EXPERIENCE (4.4 Years)

Capgemini (Business Analyst)

Conducting requirement gathering, stakeholder discussions, and UX workshops for the development of an Export & Import (EXIM) Portal, ensuring alignment between business needs and product design.

Documenting business requirements, process flows, and user stories while supporting development teams with requirement clarification and solution validation.

Neviton Softech Pvt Ltd (Business Analyst 7 Months)

As a Business Analyst, I leverage JIRA, Excel, and AI tools to manage requirements, analyze data, and support informed decision-making. I handle change requests by assessing impact, updating documentation, and aligning stakeholders to ensure smooth project functioning. I apply strong critical thinking, conduct effective meetings, resolve team conflicts, and manage end-to-end project delivery with a 100% on-time delivery track record.

Wipro limited (Business Analyst 1.4 Years)

Business Analyst with hands-on experience supporting Uber’s Maps and Eats teams. Delivered data-driven insights to optimize delivery performance, improve map accuracy, and enhance user experience. Skilled in SQL, Tableau, and Excel for data analysis, reporting, and dashboard creation. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define product requirements, document BRDs/FRDs, and drive feature enhancements. Successfully reduced SLA breaches, improved order conversion and enhanced ETA accuracy. Coordinated project timelines, approvals, and deliverables through Adobe Workfront, enhancing visibility and alignment across marketing, product, and operations teams.

Wipro limited (Senior Associate 2.2 years)

I Worked for 2.4 years as Associate and Senior Associate in the Sales and IT domain, supporting client operations, coordinating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring smooth execution of deliverables. Gained hands-on experience in data reporting, system support, and process coordination while contributing to CRM and internal tool enhancements.

PROJECTS

Export and Import (EXIM Portal): Working on an EXIM Portal focused on the digitalization of SEZ and STPI operations. Responsible for gathering and analyzing business requirements, conducting stakeholder discussions, and documenting user stories, process flows, and functional requirements. Collaborating with UX/UI and development teams to design efficient workflows and user-centric solutions. Ensuring adherence to SEZ regulations, Customs Act requirements, and statutory compliance standards. Supporting the development of audit trails, MIS reporting, and compliance monitoring features to enhance audit readiness, operational visibility, and control. Contributing to risk reduction and data integrity by defining validation rules and governance requirements.

RegIntel: Worked as a Business Analyst on the Regulatory Intelligence (Regintel) platform, a centralized system supporting regulatory content ingestion, triage, review, validation, and auditability. Led requirement gathering and prepared User Requirement Specifications (URS) covering business processes, workflows, roles, access controls, notifications, and reporting. Maintained JIRA boards, created and tracked user stories, defects, and change requests, and ensured timely closure through regular follow-ups. Conducted cross-functional stakeholder meetings, requirement walkthroughs, and impact assessments. Actively participated in Scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Supported UAT cycles, coordinated issue resolution with development and A teams, and ensured solutions aligned with compliance standards, traceability, and operational efficiency.

ARETE: End-to-End Hiring & Interview Management System

As a Business Analyst, I worked on designing and optimizing an end-to-end hiring lifecycle within a recruitment software application. I collaborated with HR, recruitment, and leadership stakeholders to gather business



requirements and translate them into functional workflows covering job requisition creation and approvals, multi-platform job posting, and candidate application intake. I defined system requirements for resume parsing to auto-create candidate profiles and enabled recruiter-led screening and shortlisting based on configurable skill and eligibility criteria. I supported the integration of online quizzes and Mercer | Mettl assessments to evaluate technical, cognitive, and behavioral competencies, ensuring assessment results were mapped to decision-making dashboards. I helped design interview scheduling, structured feedback capture, and consolidated candidate views to support data-driven hiring decisions. Additionally, I contributed to offer generation, digital communication, background verification, and onboarding workflows, ensuring seamless handoffs across the recruitment lifecycle and improved hiring efficiency

UBER EATS, UBER MAPS - Experienced Business Analyst with over 2+ years at Wipro, driving data-backed decision-making for Uber Technologies across Uber Eats and Maps projects. Proven expertise in gathering and translating business requirements into actionable insights, enhancing product features, and optimizing user experience. Skilled in stakeholder management, process improvement, and performance reporting, with a strong grasp of data tools like SQL, Excel, and internal analytics platforms. Successfully collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve delivery logistics, map accuracy, and platform efficiency

INSURANCE PROJECT - Automate the Insurance Claim processing so that the lead time taken to process a claim is reduced. Reduce manual tasks and paperwork, have a central repository of claim requests which facilitates quicker search and retrieval.

SKILLS

Technical Skills: Power BI | JIRA | Confluence | Tableau | Lucid chart, Microsoft Visio, Draw.io | Data Analysis & Visualization | Balsamiq, Figma, Visual Paradigm | SQL | Selenium, Zephyr, Bugzilla| Python (basic scripting for analysis) | Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Macros) | Data Modeling | Data Warehousing | JIRA (Agile Project Management) | Adobe Campaign, Adobe

Core Competencies: Agile (Scrum) Methodology | BRD, FRD, SRS Documentation | SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) | Reporting & Automation | Data-Driven Decision Making | Business Intelligence.

Soft Skills: Agile (Scrum) | Analytical Thinking | Effective Communication | Team Collaboration | Time Management | Adaptability | Negotiation skills | Problem Solving.

CERTIFICATIONS

Business Analyst Certification (Interactive Learning Solutions)

Professional Diploma in Agile and Scrum (Udemy)

Microsoft Power BI Desktop for Business Intelligence (Udemy)

LANGUAGES:

English | Hindi | Kannada
